name: solvepool
displayName: SolvePool — shared solutions, suggested as you type
description: Rooms of distilled, anonymized solutions to recurring problems, stored as GitHub Issues that anyone can read without an account. A hook checks every prompt against the rooms and suggests matches; a skill helps you share your own solution back. No server, no payment, your data stays on GitHub.

rooms_repos.title: Rooms repositories
rooms_repos.description: Comma-separated GitHub repositories whose Issues labelled 'room' are searched. Leave empty for the public default Luca-003/solvepool-rooms. Add a private repo of your team to get private rooms (a GitHub token is then required: GITHUB_TOKEN or `gh auth login`).
